Definition: middle voice of G757 (through the implication, of precedence); to commence (in order of time):--(rehearse from the) begin(-ning).
BiblicalUsage: The word is the middle voice of to rule, used for beginning, and it marks the great beginnings. From that time Jesus began to preach, saying, Repent, for the kingdom of heaven is at hand, and Jesus Himself began to be about thirty years of age when He stepped into His ministry.
TheologicalSignificance: The beginning of Jesus' preaching is a call to repent, and the kingdom it announces is still the same call today.
